% Non-uniform scale and rotation of the picture act on the axis image as a
% canvas transformation (behaviour Z1).
\begin{tikzpicture}[xscale=1.3, yscale=0.75, rotate=8]
\begin{axis}[xlabel={$t$}, ylabel={$y$}, grid=major]
\addplot+[smooth] coordinates {(1,2) (2,3.5) (3,2.5) (4,4.2)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
